title: Undead Rising
description: Widow Sarel found her husband standing in his own open grave and put him down herself with a hoe. The graves near Willow Dale keep opening, and whatever is cut into that totem keeps pulling them up.

objectives.description: Put the risen dead back down

notes: Threat: named villager Widow Sarel had to put her own husband back in the ground; graves near Willow Dale keep opening faster than the village can manage. Giver motive: common folk pooling coin because nobody wants to keep doing what Sarel did. Refusal: more graves open, more families do what Sarel did alone. The totem's maker is left unstated on purpose - inventing one risks the bible's open goblin-king/soulstone mechanism, which this file does not touch.
